title: Hope needs no impossible guarantee

captions.energy: Leaving an unsound measure of interest
captions.emotions: Feeling attached to promised complete clarity

meaning: You can speak of understanding words better and leave a false measure of mutual interest, noticing attachment to a promise of complete clarity wanted in place of an unknown future.
text: The Star in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in words about understanding each other better. The Tower in energy supports readiness to leave a false measure of interest: that one misunderstanding proves complete indifference. The Devil in emotions brings attachment to a promise of total clarity. You can hope for good conversation while strongly wanting words that would exclude future doubt. Wanting a guarantee does not make it possible.

For example, you say, “It would be lovely to understand everything from the first word one day”. Discussing a recent mistake reveals that it does not cancel what was genuinely heard before. **Hope for understanding requires no promise of infallibility**. Yet “I will always understand you” may feel especially wanted, as though it would restore calm that a particular explanation cannot provide. You can name this pull without making it a compulsory condition for continuing; an actual answer remains significant without an impossible guarantee.

Difficulty grows if useful clarification is rejected simply because it concerns one instance. No real reply seems sufficient without a promise covering the entire future. Constructive Tower energy helps recognise this unsound support and return to actual words. You can accept partial clarity and preserve hope for more; attachment to a wanted formula has room without assigning duties for both or proving that understanding is impossible without it.
